title: [storage] Days until the disk is full from a 7-day fit of the free disk's daily readings, with the fall a day and the store that grew most, on /api/core-lines
prompt:
Spawn, objective 141 [storage]: on /api/core-lines, "Days until the disk is full" comes from the disk itself: a 7-day fit of the daily free-disk readings. Two figures go beside it: the free disk lost a day, and the store that grew most. Asked by projects-47 for lead-mac's storage line (2026-11-14 02:39).

Where things stand (main 853b5460):
- The storage line's north star `storage.days_left` is health.storage's `days_left`. That is the free disk over the growth of the stores that persist (objective 085: the transcript archive, Claude Code's transcripts, the database and the session backups).
- On live on 11-14 that growth is 0.58 GB a day, so the figure said 136 days. The free disk's own trend fell from 129 GB (11-12) to 79 GB (11-13) in a day: builds, reviewer scratch and workspaces are no store, so the figure said months where the disk had days.
- The loop samples every figure hourly (`host.core_lines`, objective 090), `storage.free_bytes` among them, and the answer reads the window's samples for the trends.

Read: crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines.rs (`core_lines_timed`, `lines_at`, `sample_values`, `Figure`, `figure_json`, `group_of`), core_lines/storage.rs, core_lines/trends.rs, crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/storage.rs (`growth_parts`, `days_left`), web/src/coreLines.ts, rsi/scenarios/090.sh.

Required behaviour (new module crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines/disk.rs).
- The readings: for each UTC day of the trend's window (today and the 6 before) before today, that day's last `host.core_lines` sample carrying a number for `storage.free_bytes`; then the free disk now (the answer's own `free_bytes`) at now. Today's samples are left out: the reading now stands for today.
- The fall: the negated slope of the least-squares line through the readings (time in days, bytes), rounded, in bytes a day. It is below zero when the disk gains. It has no value until the readings span a day.
- `storage.days_left` ("Days until the disk is full", days): the free disk over the fall, rounded down. It has no value when either is unknown or the disk does not fall. While the fall has no value, the figure says `measuring_since_ms`: a day after the first reading.
- New guardrails, after the seven of today:
  - `storage.disk_fall`, "Free disk lost a day" (bytes_per_day): the fall;
  - `storage.grew_most`, "Store that grew most" (bytes_per_day, said with `store`). Of health.storage's `growth_parts` that have a value (archive, projects, database, session_backups), and `unattributed` (the fall less the sum of those, what no named store accounts for), it is the one that grew most and its bytes a day. A tie goes to the store named first. It has no value without a fall. It belongs to the `storage` kept group, as the sizes do.
- A figure may name a store: the answer says `store` beside it. The card (web/src/coreLines.ts) says it after the figure's name: "Store that grew most: unattributed".
- The hourly sample holds the new figures as it holds every figure with a value. `sample_values` reads the window's samples for the fit (one read an hour).
- Nothing else changes:
  - `/api/fleet`'s health.storage (its `days_left` at the stores' growth, and the Resources page's "about N days at the growth of …", which says what it measures) is as it was;
  - every other figure, range and alert rule is as it was.
- Polled read: none added per request. `/api/core-lines` already reads the window's `host.core_lines` samples for the trends; that read now comes before the figures and serves both. The hourly sample gains that same read (`spawn_events_host_core_lines`, timed today as the answer's `trends_ms`).

Unit tests:
- core_lines/disk.rs:
  - the readings are each earlier day's last sample and now (today's, outside the window, and without the figure left out);
  - the fall is the fit's, it is below zero when the disk gains, and it has no value under a day of span;
  - days left are rounded down and have no value when the disk is not falling;
  - the store that grew most counts what no store accounts for;
  - with_disk sets the days from the fit, and the measuring start while measuring.
- core_lines/storage.rs `the_storage_line_reads_health_storage` (not renamed): it gains the two figures, the `store` said, and the measuring start.
- core_lines/observability.rs and core_lines.rs `a_sample_holds_every_figure_with_a_value` (not renamed): their figure counts gain the two new ones (not measured 15 → 17).
- web/test/coreLines.test.ts: a figure that names its store says it after its name.
Each rule removed alone must fail a test or the scenario. No test is renamed or dropped.

Files: crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/core_lines.rs, core_lines/disk.rs (new), core_lines/storage.rs, core_lines/observability.rs (test only), web/src/coreLines.ts, web/test/coreLines.test.ts, rsi/scenarios/141.sh (new). No other open objective touches them.
The throwaway is +728 −13 on 853b5460: code and doc comments about +180 −7 (disk.rs +133, storage.rs +28 −6, core_lines.rs +9, coreLines.ts +10 −1); Rust tests about +172 −6 and the web test +15; 141.sh +361. Within the size guide.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/141.sh. Black box through `spawn serve`'s GET /api/core-lines and web/src/coreLines.ts under node. The readings are `host.core_lines` samples seeded as the loop records them (control records, as 090.sh seeds them); the free disk now is the answer's own.
(1) With no reading but now: days_left has no value and says `measuring_since_ms` a day after now; disk_fall and grew_most have no value.
(2) With readings 6, 3 and 1 days ago on a line falling 10 GiB a day to the free disk now: disk_fall is 10 GiB a day (within 1%); days_left is the answer's free disk over it, rounded down, with no measuring start; grew_most is `unattributed` (no store measured, so all of the fall) at the fall, in bytes_per_day.
(3) The card's storage row names "Store that grew most: unattributed" and "Free disk lost a day".
On the base (853b5460), 141.sh exits 1 with 4 checks failed. The first is "(1) with no reading but now, days_left says when it is first measured, a day after now ([1794686978575, 1794686978701]): got none ({"key":"storage.days_left","name":"Days…": the base's days_left is the stores' growth, null with no store measured, and says no measuring start. On the throwaway:

- check-clippy, cargo fmt --check, serve:: and alerts::guardrails, the web tests (node --test test/) and tsc --noEmit pass. The test list gains the 5 disk.rs names, and none is missing.
